issues.title: Indian Men Storm Into Commonwealth Kabaddi Championship Semifinals With 48-20 Win Over Tanzania | Watch
issues.title_en: Indian Men Storm Into Commonwealth Kabaddi Championship Semifinals With 48-20 Win Over Tanzania | Watch
issues.summary: India stormed into the Commonwealth Kabaddi Championship semifinals with a dominant 48-20 win over Tanzania in Ahmedabad. Neeraj Narwal led the raiding attack with 12 points, while Shubham Shinde spearheaded the defence. India will face Sri Lanka on October 29.
